caption_used: 该柱状图展示了2022年7月1日至8月26日期间全球每日新增新冠确诊病例数量与相关新闻媒体报道数量的变化趋势。蓝绿色柱状图表示当日确诊病例数，蓝色折线图表示新闻报道数量。整体来看，新闻报道数量在7月中旬达到峰值约4,200篇，随后呈现持续下降趋势；而确诊病例数在8月初出现明显高峰，单日最高超过1,200,000例。值得注意的是，两条数据序列在整个观测期间始终保持高度同步的正相关波动，未出现显著的时间滞后效应。
raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The chart is a combination of a bar graph and a line graph, with the x-axis representing dates from July 1, 2022, to August 26, 2022, and the y-axis on the left side representing the number of new confirmed COVID-19 cases, while the y-axis on the right side represents the number of news media reports. The blue bars indicate the daily number of new confirmed COVID-19 cases, and the blue line represents the number of news media reports. The chart shows that the number of news media reports peaked around mid-July at approximately 4,200 reports and then declined steadily. The number of new confirmed COVID-19 cases reached a significant peak in early August, with the highest single day exceeding 1,200,000 cases. Throughout the entire observation period, the two data sequences maintained a high positive correlation without any significant time lag effect.
